notes.title: Story Trailer Revealed! Official Website & Store Page Relaunched!
notes.content:
[h2]The Story Trailer is Finally Here![/h2][p]
In conjunction with our presence at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025, we've unveiled a new Story Trailer packed with the game's world and immersive gameplay![/p][p]Set on the collapsed planet of Voltissia, the trailer showcases intense combat scenes and encounters with unique characters that mark the beginning of the story.[/p][p]Experience the birth of a new hero in this new footage.[/p][previewyoutube="lwue9jF8NiM;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Official Website & Store Page Relaunched![/h2][p]
Along with the trailer's release, we have also relaunched our official website and Steam store page.[/p][p]On our website, you can find more detailed information on Voltissia's history, its characters, and the game's core systems.[/p][p][url="https://www.undefeated-game.com/en/undefeated-genesis" style="button"]Official Website[/url][/p][p]We've also added new screenshots and the latest information to the Steam store page.[/p][p]Be sure to check it out and add the game to your Wishlist![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We will continue to provide updates on our development progress and the latest news.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Links[/h2][list][*][p][url="https://x.com/UNDEFEATED_GAME"]X (Twitter)[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/T6R2jPvMmX"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLw5PqIEVB8jfsuX1VVScCPIFqu4XX_er1"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.undefeated-game.com/en"]Web[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: TOKYO GAME SHOW 2024 Exhibit Report
notes.content:
We exhibited “UNDEFEATED: Genesis”, a superhero action RPG currently in development, at “[url=https://events.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2024/en/exhibitor/][b]TOKYO GAME SHOW 2024[/b][/url]”, one of Japan's largest gaming events, held at Makuhari Messe from September 26 to September 29 this year.

We had many people try out the game and received a lot of positive feedback!
Thank you to everyone who stopped by “UNDEFEATED: Genesis”.

We will be displaying a modified version of the game at future events so that visitors can enjoy it even more.

We will continue to work sincerely on the development of not only the demo play but also the full product version, and we look forward to your continued support.

notes.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis is coming to PS5!
notes.content:
[b]Dear superhero fans who are eagerly awaiting 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis',[/b]

Hi! This is the "UNDEFEATED" dev team.
Thank you for your continued support of 'UNDEFEATED'. It truly means a lot to all of us.

We are very excited to be able to make this announcement to you today to announce that the latest title in the UNDEFEATED series, which we are currently developing, 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis', will be released not only on PC (Steam), but also on PlayStation 5.
The publisher is the same as the Steam version, Chorus Worldwide.

Along with the decision to release the game on PS5, we have decided to change the logo for UNDEFEATED: Genesis.
We promise to deliver the best superhero experience to you, so please look forward to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738004/a90e4dbe6154bfa87d0bc53d4970ec99c5565282.jpg[/img]
In addition, the free superhero game 'UNDEFEATED', which has been downloaded over 2 million times worldwide and is loved by everyone, will also be released on PS5.

[previewyoutube=g3rkF0VPWKQ;full]https://youtu.be/g3rkF0VPWKQ?si=JvsAf3BLNsBLre7k[/previewyoutube]
The PS5 version of UNDEFEATED includes 4K support and the latest updates that will be released for the PC (Steam) version, and you can play it for [u][b]FREE[/b][/u].
Experience the invincible superhero not only on PC (Steam), but also on PS5!

[h2]PlayStation Store[/h2]
[list]
[*]UNDEFEATED: Genesis (Scheduled to launch in 2026): [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011831]https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011831[/url]
[quote=author]Don't forget to add your wishlist on the PlayStation Store![/quote] [*]UNDEFEATED (Free): [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011751]https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011751[/url]
[/list]
[h2]About UNDEFEATED[/h2]
'UNDEFEATED' was originally a student project from Vantan Game Academy in Japan that was released for free on Steam in August 2019. As of September 2024, it has been downloaded over 2 million times worldwide.
The aim of the game was to make players feel like a real superhero, flying freely around a city and wielding awesome powers to save the inhabitants with a simple and intuitive control method.
'UNDEFEATED' has received high praise from many superhero fans and gamers, especially from international players.

After graduating from Vantan Game Academy, the development team gained experience in the gaming industry and then reunited at Indie-us Games in Osaka, Japan, where they are currently working on 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis,' the latest installment in the UNDEFEATED series, with a planned release in 2026.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/

[h2]What's 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis'?[/h2]
'UNDEFEATED: Genesis' is a superhero action game set on a massive alien planet.
Developed in Unreal Engine 5, the game builds on 'UNDEFEATED' and the feeling of being a superhero, but is vastly scaled up in scope, technology, and story. In 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis', players will experience flying across a huge environment, developing and using astounding superpowers, and experiencing a rich storyline.
The game is being developed with the intention of delivering a true "superhero experience" to fans and aims to make players feel the same sense of power as heroes in comics and manga.

'UNDEFEATED: Genesis' takes place in the same universe as 'UNDEFEATED' and narratively serves as its prequel.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/

To celebrate the [b]PS5 release[/b] and [b]2 million downloads[/b] of the previous title 'UNDEFEATED', an update has been released that adds new elements to the game.

notes.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis will be exhibited at BitSummit Drift! [IP-41]
notes.content:
[url=https://bitsummit.org/en/ticket-2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738004/a47607de702d6fd0fc68140182bfe7089e428266.png[/img][/url]

We are pleased to announce that we will be exhibiting at [url=https://bitsummit.org/en/]BitSummit Drift[/url], one of the largest indie game festivals in Japan, to be held from July 19 to 21, 2024, at "Miyakomesse" in Kyoto. At the event, we will exhibit [b]a demo focusing on the combat part of our Superhero Action RPG "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/]UNDEFEATED: Genesis[/url]", which is currently in development.[/b]

[h2]What is "UNDEFEATED: Genesis"?[/h2]
[b]"[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/]UNDEFEATED: Genesis[/url]"[/b] is a superhero action game set on a massive planet.

We are developing a game where you can experience being the [b]ultimate superhero[/b] by freely flying around vast fields and using a variety of superpowers to defeat enemies, aiming for a spring 2026 release. This game was developed with the intention of delivering a [b]"hero experience"[/b] to hero enthusiasts worldwide and aims to make players feel the same [b]"strength"[/b] as heroes in comics and manga. Additionally, it shares the same universe as its predecessor [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/]UNDEFEATED[/url], serving as its prequel.

[previewyoutube=OmTto6ULNd0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]"UNDEFEATED" and "UNDEFEATED: Genesis"[/h3]
The previous game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/]UNDEFEATED[/url] was our first project, released for free on Steam in August 2019 as an open-world hero game. With the theme of [b]"undefeated"[/b], it is a very simple game where an invincible hero flies around the city and defeats enemies with a single button. At that time, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/]UNDEFEATED[/url], developed by vocational school students, was well-received by many hero fans and game enthusiasts, especially overseas, and was downloaded over 2 million times.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/

[h2]Game Play[/h2]
"[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/]UNDEFEATED: Genesis[/url]" is a [b]"Superhero Action RPG"[/b] where a young man awakens to [b]"Superpowers"[/b] after an encounter with a meteor and battles planetary creatures.

You can acquire various superpowers using the [b]"ability to incorporate genes and manifest new powers"[/b], customizing yourself into your own unique hero.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/46d360_0890428e96fc448c93a2e8591cc94b66~mv2.gif[/img]

The massive planet is divided into various biomes such as grasslands, forests, seas, snowfields, and volcanoes, which you can experience from land, sea, and air. As a hero, find and help those in need, clear paths, give materials, and assist the people living on the planet.

At BitSummit Drift, we will exhibit a "combat-focused DEMO". You can freely fly around a part of the planet and experience battles with planetary creatures.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/46d360_068e1220da8f436b90f0fb00269d747e~mv2.gif[/img]

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/46d360_7b62c6e07d4246dca4a0265cd6c50a37~mv2.gif[/img]

We look forward to seeing you all at the event!

notes.title: We have a new name for the game!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have a couple of very exciting announcements today. Firstly, you may have noticed we have changed the name of the game. Unrestricted is now [i]UNDEFEATED: Genesis[/i]! As this is the sequel to our first project, Undefeated, we wanted to change the name to reflect that, and as this will be the first in a trilogy of games, we begin our story with ‘Genesis’...  

We are also now partnering with our friends at Chorus Worldwide games to publish [i]UNDEFEATED: Genesis[/i]. If you are lucky enough to be at the Tokyo Games Show next month you can come and see the game on the Chorus stand!

We also revealed some new footage for the game that we are really excited to share with you… 

[previewyoutube=BKjkS9JyIwY;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
Don’t forget you can still see where our story began and play our very first project, UNDEFEATED. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/

We’ve learned so much since working on that game as students and we can’t wait to show you more of [i]UNDEFEATED: Genesis[/i] as we work on the game. 

We hope you like what you see. If you do, don’t forget to wishlist the game!

Thanks

Indie-us
